caption_en: The Simple page with the First Murmur preset: the flock on the left, the small knobs below, Shape the cloud on the right.
caption_es: La página Simple con el preset First Murmur: la bandada a la izquierda, las perillas chicas abajo y Shape the cloud a la derecha.

caption_en: The top bar: the logo, the input and output meters, the preset selector, Save, Simple, Advanced and Manual.
caption_es: La barra superior: el logo, los medidores de entrada y salida, el selector de presets, Save, Simple, Advanced y Manual.

caption_en: The flock view with the Starling Cloud preset: grains spread across the last seconds and across the stereo field.
caption_es: La bandada con el preset Starling Cloud: granos repartidos en los últimos segundos y a lo ancho del estéreo.

caption_en: The flock view with the Octave Shower preset: birds in rows one and two octaves above and below the original pitch.
caption_es: La bandada con el preset Octave Shower: pájaros en filas una y dos octavas arriba y abajo de la altura original.

caption_en: The Shape the cloud panel with the Choir Rising preset: six big knobs and Freeze.
caption_es: El panel Shape the cloud con el preset Choir Rising: seis perillas grandes y Freeze.

caption_en: The row of small knobs with the Octave Shower preset: Position, Pitch Random, Shimmer, Reverse, Reverb and Delay.
caption_es: La fila de perillas chicas con el preset Octave Shower: Position, Pitch Random, Shimmer, Reverse, Reverb y Delay.

caption_en: The Simple page with the Tape Scatter preset: twelve seconds of buffer, grains scattered over four seconds and half of them reversed.
caption_es: La página Simple con el preset Tape Scatter: doce segundos de búfer, granos desparramados en cuatro segundos y la mitad en reversa.

caption_en: The Advanced page with the First Murmur preset.
caption_es: La página Advanced con el preset First Murmur.

caption_en: The Grains and Time panels with the Sixteenth Stutter preset: Sync on 1/16 with a Chance of 70 %.
caption_es: Los paneles Grains y Time con el preset Sixteenth Stutter: Sync en 1/16 con un Chance de 70 %.

caption_en: The Pitch and Envelope and stereo panels with the Glass Halo preset: Pitch +12, Pitch Random 12 st snapped to Octaves.
caption_es: Los paneles Pitch y Envelope and stereo con el preset Glass Halo: Pitch +12 y Pitch Random de 12 st ajustado a Octaves.

caption_en: The Tone and level and LFO 1 panels with the Breathing Cloud preset: LFO 1 moves Density with a slow sine.
caption_es: Los paneles Tone and level y LFO 1 con el preset Breathing Cloud: LFO 1 mueve Density con un seno lento.

caption_en: The LFO 2 and Effects and MIDI panels with the Breathing Cloud preset: LFO 2 moves Pan with a slow drift.
caption_es: Los paneles LFO 2 y Effects and MIDI con el preset Breathing Cloud: LFO 2 mueve Pan con una deriva lenta.

caption_en: The manual open inside the plugin, from the Manual button in the top bar.
caption_es: El manual abierto adentro del plugin, desde el botón Manual de la barra superior.
